API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIAdvanced SettingsAdvanced Settings Resource Update Advanced Settings
Advanced Settings Resource Update Advanced Settings
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/advancedSettings

Updates the advanced settings configuration in the ZIA Admin Portal. To learn more, see Configuring Advanced Settings.

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODYREQUIRED

Advanced settings in the ZIA Admin Portal

authBypassUrlCategories
object[]
domainFrontingBypassUrlCategories
object[]
authBypassUrls
string[]

Custom URLs that are exempted from cookie authentication for users

authBypassApps
object[]
kerberosBypassUrlCategories
object[]
kerberosBypassUrls
string[]

Custom URLs that are exempted from Kerberos authentication

kerberosBypassApps
object[]
basicBypassUrlCategories
object[]
basicBypassApps
object[]
httpRangeHeaderRemoveUrlCategories
object[]
digestAuthBypassUrlCategories
object[]
digestAuthBypassUrls
string[]

Custom URLs that are exempted from Digest authentication

digestAuthBypassApps
object[]
enableDnsResolutionOnTransparentProxy
boolean

A Boolean value indicating whether DNS optimization is enabled or disabled for Z-Tunnel 2.0 and mode traffic (e.g., traffic via GRE or IPSec tunnels without a PAC file). This setting allows Zscaler to perform a DNS lookup and override the externally resolved IP addresses in the outbound HTTP and HTTPS connections to establish a connection to the destination server that is geographically closer to the ZIA Service Edge (Public, Private, or Virtual).

enableIPv6DnsResolutionOnTransparentProxy
boolean

A Boolean value indicating whether DNS optimization is enabled or disabled for IPv6 traffic sent via Z-Tunnel 2.0 and mode traffic (e.g., traffic via GRE or IPSec tunnels without a PAC file).

enableIPv6DnsOptimizationOnAllTransparentProxy
boolean

A Boolean value indicating whether DNS optimization is enabled or disabled for all IPv6 transparent proxy traffic

enableEvaluatePolicyOnGlobalSSLBypass
boolean

A Boolean value indicating whether policy evaluation for global SSL bypass traffic is enabled or not

dnsResolutionOnTransparentProxyExemptUrlCategories
object[]
dnsResolutionOnTransparentProxyIPv6ExemptUrlCategories
object[]
dnsResolutionOnTransparentProxyExemptUrls
string[]

URLs that are excluded from DNS optimization on transparent proxy mode

dnsResolutionOnTransparentProxyExemptApps
object[]
dnsResolutionOnTransparentProxyIPv6ExemptApps
object[]
dnsResolutionOnTransparentProxyUrlCategories
object[]
dnsResolutionOnTransparentProxyIPv6UrlCategories
object[]
dnsResolutionOnTransparentProxyUrls
string[]

URLs to which DNS optimization on transparent proxy mode applies

dnsResolutionOnTransparentProxyApps
object[]
dnsResolutionOnTransparentProxyIPv6Apps
object[]
blockDomainFrontingApps
object[]
preferSniOverConnHostApps
object[]
enableOffice365
boolean

A Boolean value indicating whether Microsoft Office 365 One Click Configuration is enabled or not

logInternalIp
boolean

A Boolean value indicating whether to log internal IP address present in X-Forwarded-For (XFF) proxy header or not

enforceSurrogateIpForWindowsApp
boolean

Enforce Surrogate IP authentication for Windows app traffic

trackHttpTunnelOnHttpPorts
boolean

A Boolean value indicating whether to apply configured policies on tunneled HTTP traffic sent via a CONNECT method request on port 80

blockHttpTunnelOnNonHttpPorts
boolean

A Boolean value indicating whether HTTP CONNECT method requests to non-standard ports are allowed or not (i.e., requests directed to ports other than the standard HTTP and HTTPS ports, 80 and 443)

blockDomainFrontingOnHostHeader
boolean

A Boolean value indicating whether to block HTTP and HTTPS transactions that have an FQDN mismatch between:

The request URL and the request's host header. The service doesn't consider it a mismatch if either of the fields, host header, or FQDN URL is empty.
The SNI and the inner request's host header. The service doesn't consider it a mismatch if either of the fields, host header, or SNI is empty.
zscalerClientConnector1AndPacRoadWarriorInFirewall
boolean

A Boolean value indicating whether to apply the Firewall rules configured without a specified location criteria (or with the Road Warrior location) to remote user traffic forwarded via Z-Tunnel 1.0 or PAC files

cascadeUrlFiltering
boolean

A Boolean value indicating whether to apply the URL Filtering policy even when the Cloud App Control policy already allows a transaction explicitly

enablePolicyForUnauthenticatedTraffic
boolean

A Boolean value indicating whether policies that include user and department criteria can be configured and applied for unauthenticated traffic

blockNonCompliantHttpRequestOnHttpPorts
boolean

A Boolean value indicating whether to allow or block traffic that is not compliant with RFC HTTP protocol standards

enableAdminRankAccess
boolean

A Boolean value indicating whether ranks are enabled for admins to allow admin ranks in policy configuration and management

uiSessionTimeout
int32

Specifies the login session timeout for admins accessing the ZIA Admin Portal

http2NonbrowserTrafficEnabled
boolean

A Boolean value indicating whether or not HTTP/2 should be the default web protocol for accessing various applications at your organizational level

ecsForAllEnabled
boolean

A Boolean value indicating whether or not to include the ECS option in all DNS queries, originating from all locations and remote users.

ecsObject
object
dynamicUserRiskEnabled
boolean

A Boolean value indicating whether to dynamically update user risk score by tracking risky user activities in real time

blockConnectHostSniMismatch
boolean

A Boolean value indicating whether CONNECT host and SNI mismatch (i.e., CONNECT host doesn't match the SSL/TLS client hello SNI) is blocked or not

preferSniOverConnHost
boolean

A Boolean value indicating whether or not to use the SSL/TLS client hello Server Name Indication (SNI) for DNS resolution instead of the CONNECT host for forward proxy connections

sipaXffHeaderEnabled
boolean

A Boolean value indicating whether or not to insert XFF header to all traffic forwarded from ZIA to ZPA, including source IP-anchored and ZIA-inspected ZPA application traffic.

blockNonHttpOnHttpPortEnabled
boolean

A Boolean value indicating whether non-HTTP Traffic on HTTP and HTTPS ports are allowed or blocked

sniDnsOptimizationBypassUrlCategories
object[]
Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
